FullDescription:
A quiet novel about a lighthouse keeper whose solitary winter is interrupted by an unexpected guest. E-book in PDF format.

What this product shows: A download product. Before buying, customers can download a free reading sample. After the order has been paid, the e-book is available for download in the customer account. No shipping costs apply, and the reduced tax rate for books is used.
Name: The Quiet Harbour (E-Book)
ShortDescription: A novel about a lighthouse keeper and an unexpected guest. E-book, PDF.

FullDescription:
Photo editing software for Windows, macOS and Linux with all the tools for everyday pictures: crop, adjust light and colours, remove red eyes.

What this product shows: A software download with a licence agreement that must be accepted before downloading. The download can be used up to three times and expires after 30 days. The current program version is shown with the download.
Name: Pixelmoor Photo Studio
ShortDescription: Photo editing software for Windows, macOS and Linux. Download with licence agreement.
UserAgreementText:
This is the licence agreement of the demo software Pixelmoor Photo Studio. Customers have to accept it before they can download the software.

The software may be installed on up to two private computers. It may not be passed on or sold.

FullDescription:
Mild and fruity, cold-pressed from hand-picked olives. Ideal for salads, fresh bread and for finishing warm dishes.

What this product shows: Below the price you see the base price, here the price per litre. It lets customers compare bottles of different sizes at a glance. The shop works it out from the content of the bottle and the price.
Name: Extra Virgin Olive Oil 500 ml
ShortDescription: Cold-pressed extra virgin olive oil, 500 ml bottle.

FullDescription:
Medium-dark roasted arabica beans with notes of cocoa and hazelnut. Choose the pack size and how finely the coffee should be ground.

What this product shows: Every combination of pack size and grind is its own article with its own item number, stock and price. Switch from 250 g to 1 kg and watch the price, the base price per kilogram, the item number and the delivery time change: the large pack is cheaper per kilogram, but is roasted to order.
Name: Roasted Coffee
ShortDescription: Freshly roasted arabica beans, in two pack sizes and three grinds.

FullDescription:
250 g of freshly roasted coffee beans, delivered to your door once a month for twelve months.

What this product shows: A product with a recurring order. In the product settings you define how often and how many times the order repeats, here every month, twelve times. Customers choose the date of the first delivery in a calendar and can add delivery notes in a text box with several lines.
Name: Coffee Subscription
ShortDescription: Your favourite coffee, delivered every month.

FullDescription:
A blend of oregano, thyme, rosemary and basil in a 100 g jar. Perfect for grilled vegetables, pasta and roast potatoes.

What this product shows: A simple product without variants: picture, price, delivery time and a table of product properties. These properties, such as origin and dietary information, can also be used as filters in the category, so customers can narrow down the list, for example to vegan products.
Name: Mediterranean Herb Mix 100 g
ShortDescription: Oregano, thyme, rosemary and basil in a 100 g jar.

FullDescription:
A ready-made gift: olive oil and two herb mixes in one box.

What this product shows: A bundle. The contents are listed on the product page. Each item is priced individually with a 25 % reduction, so the box is cheaper than buying the items separately.
Name: Gourmet Gift Box
ShortDescription: Olive oil and two herb mixes in one gift box.

FullDescription:
A ceramic mill filled with coarse sea salt, adjustable from coarse to fine.

What this product shows: A product that is out of stock. The page says so clearly and offers a notification: customers leave their email address and are informed as soon as the product is available again, so a lost sale can still be won.
Name: Sea Salt Mill
ShortDescription: Ceramic mill filled with coarse sea salt.

FullDescription:
Crisp spiced cookies with cinnamon, orange and almonds, baked in small batches.

What this product shows: A product that is not available yet. A date in the product settings (“available from”) controls when it can be ordered. Until then customers can look at the product but cannot add it to the cart. Useful for new arrivals and seasonal items.
Name: Spiced Christmas Cookies
ShortDescription: Crisp spiced cookies with cinnamon, orange and almonds, 300 g.

FullDescription:
A lounge chair with a high back and wide armrests. Put it together the way you like it: cover, frame and extras.

What this product shows: A configurable product. Cover and frame are chosen with picture swatches that show the price difference directly. Each choice changes the price: linen and leather cost extra, the black steel frame is cheaper than oak. Leather also makes the chair heavier, which affects the shipping weight. Under “Extras” several options can be ticked at once. “Matching footstool” is a product of its own: if you tick it, the footstool is added to the order at its own price.

The plugin File Manager adds tabs with documents to product pages. Here the tab “Data sheet” offers the dimensions, materials and care instructions of the chair as a PDF to download.
Name: Lund Lounge Chair
ShortDescription: Lounge chair with a choice of cover, frame and extras.

FullDescription:
A floor lamp with a wide arc that reaches over sofa and armchair. The light can be dimmed.

What this product shows: Each finish shows its final price directly in the selection. The brass version is a separate article: it costs more, weighs more and is made to order, so its delivery time is longer. The lamp comes without a bulb: the matching LED bulb is a required product and is added to the cart automatically together with the lamp.

The plugin General Product Safety Regulation (GPSR) shows the manufacturer and safety information required by the EU General Product Safety Regulation in a separate tab on the product page. For this lamp, the contact details of the manufacturer Lindavero and safety notes for using the lamp are stored.

The plugin EU Warranty Labelling shows the uniform EU labels for the statutory warranty and for a voluntary durability guarantee. Lindavero gives a durability guarantee of 5 years on this lamp, so the label also shows the guarantee period, the manufacturer and the model identifier.
Name: Arc Floor Lamp
ShortDescription: Floor lamp with a wide arc and a dimmable light, in three finishes.

FullDescription:
The Oslo collection brings together a side table, a shelf and a footstool in solid oak. All pieces are designed to go together.

What this product shows: A grouped product. The pieces of the collection are listed together on one page and each can be added to the cart individually. The list is collapsible: every piece is a header line with picture, item number and price, and opens to show its details and the “Add to cart” button.
Name: Oslo Living Room Collection
ShortDescription: Side table, shelf and footstool in solid oak, designed to go together.

FullDescription:
A round side table in solid oak, 45 cm in diameter. Delivered fully assembled.

What this product shows: A product that belongs to a collection. It has its own page, but also appears on the page of the Oslo collection.
Name: Oslo Side Table
ShortDescription: Round side table in solid oak, 45 cm diameter.

FullDescription:
An open shelf in solid oak with four compartments. Quick to assemble.

What this product shows: A product with low stock. The page shows how many are left. There is no quantity field: the shelf is added to the cart one at a time.
Name: Oslo Shelf
ShortDescription: Open shelf in solid oak with four compartments.

FullDescription:
An upholstered footstool with oak legs, the perfect companion for the Lund lounge chair.

What this product shows: A new product that is also offered as an extra on another product: on the Lund lounge chair it can be added with a tick.
Name: Oslo Footstool
ShortDescription: Upholstered footstool with oak legs.

FullDescription:
A dimmable LED bulb with warm white light and an E27 socket. Fits the Arc floor lamp.

What this product shows: A product that is required by another product. When the Arc floor lamp is added to the cart, this bulb is added automatically.
Name: LED Bulb E27, dimmable
ShortDescription: Dimmable LED bulb with warm white light, E27 socket.

FullDescription:
A waterproof, breathable rain jacket with an adjustable hood and taped seams. Light enough for every day, robust enough for long walks.

What this product shows: Colour and size are variants. Each colour has its own picture, which appears when you select it. Every combination of colour and size is its own article with its own item number and stock. Sizes that are sold out in the selected colour are greyed out, for example black in XL.
Name: Fjord Rain Jacket
ShortDescription: Waterproof, breathable jacket with a hood, in four colours.

FullDescription:
A soft ribbed knit sweater with a relaxed fit and dropped shoulders. Available in a wool blend or in pure merino wool.

What this product shows: Different ways of displaying variants. The colours are large, round colour fields; patterned colours such as “grey melange” show two colours in one field. The sizes are wide boxes with their names. The material box shows the surcharge for merino wool directly.
Name: Ribbed Knit Sweater
ShortDescription: Soft ribbed knit sweater in a relaxed fit, in wool blend or merino wool.

FullDescription:
A minimalist sneaker made of smooth leather with a light rubber sole. Also available as a limited edition in black and gold.

What this product shows: The limited edition has its own price: switch the colour and the price changes. Sizes are selected in a dropdown. Some sizes are sold out; unlike the rain jacket, they are not greyed out, but the page tells you when you select one, and the “Add to cart” button disappears.

The plugin EU Warranty Labelling shows the uniform EU labels for the statutory warranty and for a voluntary durability guarantee. Norlumera gives a durability guarantee of 3 years on these sneakers, so the label also shows the guarantee period, the manufacturer and the model identifier.
Name: Urban Leather Sneaker
ShortDescription: Minimalist leather sneaker, also as a limited black and gold edition.

FullDescription:
A warm, fine-knit beanie made of merino wool. One size fits all.

What this product shows: A new product in the range, marked with the “New” label. The label disappears automatically after a set number of days.
Name: Merino Beanie
ShortDescription: Warm, fine-knit beanie made of merino wool, one size.

FullDescription:
A long, soft scarf made of wool, generous enough to wrap twice.

What this product shows: A special price for a limited period. The regular price is shown crossed out, and the special price ends automatically on a set date. The quantity is entered in a number field instead of a dropdown, because more than 100 quantities can be ordered.
Name: Wool Scarf
ShortDescription: Long, soft scarf made of wool, at a special price for a limited time.

FullDescription:
A T-shirt made of organic cotton. Wear it plain or have it printed with a text of your choice.

What this product shows: A product that customers personalise. With “With print” the price rises by the print surcharge and a text field appears for your text.

The plugin Rules for product attributes controls with rules when a product option is shown. Here the text field has the rule “Print is With print”: as long as “Without print” is selected, the text field stays hidden, and nobody can enter a text that would not be printed. Rules can combine several options, for example to offer a size only in certain colours.
Name: Organic T-Shirt with Your Print
ShortDescription: Organic cotton T-shirt, plain or with a text of your choice.

FullDescription:
The gift that always fits: a digital gift card that can be redeemed for everything in the shop.

What this product shows: A gift card. When ordering, customers enter the recipient, the sender and a personal message. After payment, the recipient receives the gift card code by email and can redeem it at checkout. The value is chosen from three amounts.
Name: Gift Card
ShortDescription: Digital gift card, sent by email. Choose 25, 50 or 100.

FullDescription:
A digital gift card for exactly the amount you have in mind, from 10 to 500.

What this product shows: A price entered by the customer. Instead of a fixed price there is an input field for the amount, with a minimum and a maximum.
Name: Gift Card with Amount of Your Choice
ShortDescription: Digital gift card with an amount between 10 and 500 that you enter yourself.

FullDescription:
Every contribution helps to plant trees in a fictional reforestation project. Choose any amount from 1.

What this product shows: A donation: the customer enters the amount freely. Donations are not shipped and no tax is charged.
Name: Donation: Plant a Tree
ShortDescription: Support a fictional reforestation project with an amount of your choice.

FullDescription:
Three-piece golf balls with a soft feel and good distance on every club. Choose a pack of 3, 12 or 24.

What this product shows: The pack size is a product variant: price and weight change with the selection. Order five or more packs and the price per pack drops (quantity discount). The hardness in the table of properties can be used as a filter in the category.

The plugin Depending prices lets you set prices that depend on the customer group, the language, the store or the customer number. For these golf balls, a club price of 8.50 instead of 9.90 has been set up for the customer group “Golf club members”. Customers in this group see the club price as soon as they are signed in, everybody else sees the normal price.
Name: Tour Distance Golf Balls
ShortDescription: Three-piece golf balls with a soft feel and good distance, in packs of 3, 12 or 24.

FullDescription:
Golf tees are small pegs that are pushed into the ground and hold the ball for the first shot of each hole. These are made of natural wood, 70 mm long, 50 pieces per bag.

What this product shows: A quantity unit (bag) and a minimum order quantity: at least two bags per order. Both are set in the product settings.
Name: Golf Tees, 50 pieces
ShortDescription: Small pegs that hold the golf ball for the tee shot. 70 mm, 50 pieces per bag.

FullDescription:
A soft leather glove for a secure grip, also in wet conditions. Choose the size and the hand you wear it on.

What this product shows: Two required variants, displayed in different ways: a radio list for the hand and a dropdown for the size. Nothing is preselected. Try adding the glove to the cart without choosing: the shop points out which selection is still missing.
Name: Leather Golf Glove
ShortDescription: Soft leather glove for a secure grip, also in wet conditions.

FullDescription:
A compact laser rangefinder with a range of up to 600 m and a slope function. Measures the distance to the flag in about a second.

What this product shows: A product without a published price. Instead of the price, the shop shows a note to ask for it. Useful for expensive products or products that need explanation.
Name: Laser Rangefinder 600
ShortDescription: Compact laser rangefinder with a range of up to 600 m and a slope function.

FullDescription:
Everything for the first round: a stand bag, two bags of tees and a divot repair tool at a special price.

What this product shows: A bundle with a fixed price. The contents are listed on the product page, but the customer pays one price for the whole set, which is lower than the sum of the parts. (The gift box in the food category prices each item individually instead.)
Name: Golf Starter Set
ShortDescription: Golf bag, two bags of tees and a divot repair tool at a special price.

FullDescription:
A lightweight stand bag with a double carry strap and six compartments. It keeps the clubs upright and comes with a rain hood.

What this product shows: A price comparison. The suggested retail price is shown crossed out next to the current price, with its label. The stock is also low, and the page shows how many bags are left.
Name: Lightweight Stand Bag
ShortDescription: Stand bag with a double carry strap and six compartments.

FullDescription:
A stainless steel divot repair tool with a magnetic ball marker. It fits in any pocket.

What this product shows: A simple, inexpensive accessory. It is also part of the starter set, where it appears as a bundle item. As a recent addition to the range, it carries the “New” label.
Name: Divot Repair Tool
ShortDescription: Stainless steel divot repair tool with a magnetic ball marker.
